mapper.sql: t.team_id AS teamId, t.leader_user_id AS leaderUserId, leader.nickname AS leaderNickname, t.name, t.description, CASE WHEN t.representative_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/team/', t.team_id) ELSE NULL END AS imageUrl, t.status, t.end_type AS endType, t.region_id AS regionId, t.region_any_yn AS regionAnyYn, rg.public_display_name AS publicRegionName, t.expected_duration AS expectedDuration, t.max_member_count AS maxMemberCount, t.current_member_count AS currentMemberCount, t.last_active_at AS lastActiveAt, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt

t.team_id AS teamId, t.leader_user_id AS leaderUserId, leader.nickname AS leaderNickname, t.name, t.description, CASE WHEN t.representative_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/team/', t.team_id) ELSE NULL END AS imageUrl, LEFT(t.description, 140) AS descriptionSummary, t.status, t.end_type AS endType, t.region_id AS regionId, t.region_any_yn AS regionAnyYn, rg.public_display_name AS publicRegionName, rg.public_display_name AS regionDisplayName, t.expected_duration AS expectedDuration, t.max_member_count AS maxMemberCount, t.current_member_count AS currentMemberCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_recruitment tr WHERE tr.team_id = t.team_id AND tr.status = 'OPEN' ) AS activeRecruitmentCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_application ta WHERE ta.team_id = t.team_id AND ta.status = 'PENDING' ) AS pendingApplicationCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_member tm WHERE tm.team_id = t.team_id AND tm.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS activeMemberCount, t.last_active_at AS lastActiveAt, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN t.status = 'ENDED' THEN t.updated_at ELSE NULL END AS endedAt, CASE WHEN t.status = 'DELETED' THEN t.updated_at ELSE NULL END AS deletedAt
mapper.select: SELECT , tm.team_role AS myTeamRole, tm.status AS myMemberStatus, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_application ta WHERE ta.team_id = t.team_id AND ta.status = 'PENDING' ) AS pendingApplicationCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_invitation ti WHERE ti.team_id = t.team_id AND ti.status = 'PENDING' ) AS pendingInvitationCount, ( SELECT p.plan_item_id FROM team_plan_item p WHERE p.team_id = t.team_id AND p.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CANCELED') AND (p.assignee_user_id IS NULL OR p.assignee_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY p.due_at IS NULL, p.due_at, p.plan_item_id LIMIT 1 ) AS nextUserPlanItemId, ( SELECT p.title FROM team_plan_item p WHERE p.team_id = t.team_id AND p.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CANCELED') AND (p.assignee_user_id IS NULL OR p.assignee_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY p.due_at IS NULL, p.due_at, p.plan_item_id LIMIT 1 ) AS nextUserPlanTitle, ( SELECT p.due_at FROM team_plan_item p WHERE p.team_id = t.team_id AND p.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CANCELED') AND (p.assignee_user_id IS NULL OR p.assignee_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY p.due_at IS NULL, p.due_at, p.plan_item_id LIMIT 1 ) AS nextUserPlanDueAt FROM team_member tm JOIN team t ON t.team_id = tm.team_id JOIN user_account leader ON leader.user_id = t.leader_user_id LEFT JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = t.region_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY t.last_active_at DESC, t.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM team t JOIN user_account leader ON leader.user_id = t.leader_user_id LEFT JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = t.region_id WHERE t.team_id = #{teamId} AND t.status != 'DELETED'
SELECT FROM team t JOIN user_account leader ON leader.user_id = t.leader_user_id LEFT JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = t.region_id WHERE t.team_id = #{teamId}
SELECT g.genre_id AS genreId, g.name FROM team_genre tg JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = tg.genre_id WHERE tg.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY g.sort_order

SELECT tm.team_member_id AS teamMemberId, tm.team_id AS teamId, tm.user_id AS userId, mp.profile_id AS profileId, u.nickname, u.email, tm.team_role AS teamRole, tm.status, tm.joined_at AS joinedAt, tm.left_at AS leftAt FROM team_member tm JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = tm.user_id LEFT JOIN member_profile mp ON mp.user_id = tm.user_id AND mp.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY FIELD(tm.team_role, 'LEADER', 'SUB_LEADER', 'MEMBER'), tm.joined_at

SELECT r.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, r.team_id AS teamId, r.title, r.status, r.deadline_at AS deadlineAt, r.work_start_at AS workStartAt, r.created_by AS createdBy, u.nickname AS createdByNickname, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM team_recruitment r JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = r.created_by WHERE r.team_id = #{teamId} AND r.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, r.team_id AS teamId, r.title, r.status, r.deadline_at AS deadlineAt, r.work_start_at AS workStartAt, r.created_by AS createdBy, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM team_recruitment r WHERE r.recruitment_id = #{recruitmentId}

SELECT s.slot_id AS slotId, s.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, s.role_id AS roleId, r.name AS roleName, rc.name AS roleCategoryName, s.required_count AS requiredCount, s.accepted_count AS acceptedCount, s.required_count - s.accepted_count AS remainingCount, s.required_experience_level AS requiredExperienceLevel, s.collaboration_condition AS collaborationCondition, s.required_yn AS requiredYn, s.role_duration AS roleDuration, s.equipment_required_yn AS equipmentRequiredYn, s.status FROM team_recruitment_slot s JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id JOIN role_category rc ON rc.role_category_id = r.role_category_id WHERE s.recruitment_id = #{recruitmentId} AND s.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY s.slot_id

SELECT s.slot_id AS slotId, s.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, tr.team_id AS teamId, s.role_id AS roleId, r.name AS roleName, rc.name AS roleCategoryName, s.required_count AS requiredCount, s.accepted_count AS acceptedCount, s.required_count - s.accepted_count AS remainingCount, s.required_experience_level AS requiredExperienceLevel, s.collaboration_condition AS collaborationCondition, s.required_yn AS requiredYn, s.role_duration AS roleDuration, s.equipment_required_yn AS equipmentRequiredYn, s.status FROM team_recruitment_slot s JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.recruitment_id = s.recruitment_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id JOIN role_category rc ON rc.role_category_id = r.role_category_id WHERE s.slot_id = #{slotId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_member tm JOIN team t ON t.team_id = tm.team_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status IN ('RECRUITING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'RECRUITMENT_CLOSED', 'CLOSING')
SELECT tm.team_role FROM team_member tm JOIN team t ON t.team_id = tm.team_id WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} AND tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status != 'DELETED' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team ( leader_user_id, name, description, status, region_id, region_any_yn, expected_duration, max_member_count, current_member_count, last_active_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{leaderUserId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, #{regionId}, #{regionAnyYn}, #{expectedDuration}, #{maxMemberCount}, 1, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE team SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, region_id = #{regionId}, region_any_yn = #{regionAnyYn}, expected_duration = #{expectedDuration}, max_member_count = #{maxMemberCount}, last_active_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId}

UPDATE team SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, region_id = #{regionId}, region_any_yn = #{regionAnyYn}, expected_duration = #{expectedDuration}, max_member_count = #{maxMemberCount}, last_active_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status NOT IN ('ENDED', 'DELETED')
UPDATE team SET status = #{status}, last_active_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status NOT IN ('ENDED', 'DELETED')
UPDATE team SET status = 'DELETED', end_type = 'DISSOLUTION', last_active_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status NOT IN ('ENDED', 'DELETED')
UPDATE team SET status = 'DELETED', end_type = 'DISSOLUTION', last_active_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE team SET leader_user_id = #{leaderUserId}, last_active_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status NOT IN ('ENDED', 'DELETED')
UPDATE team SET status = 'ENDED', end_type = #{endType}, last_active_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status NOT IN ('ENDED', 'DELETED')
UPDATE team SET status = #{status}, end_type = NULL, last_active_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status = 'ENDED'
UPDATE team SET status = #{status}, end_type = NULL, last_active_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status = 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_member (team_id, user_id, team_role, status, joined_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{userId}, #{teamRole}, 'ACTIVE', NOW())

INSERT INTO team_member (team_id, user_id, team_role, status, joined_at, left_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{userId}, #{teamRole}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE team_role = VALUES(team_role), status = 'ACTIVE', joined_at = NOW(), left_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT tm.team_member_id AS teamMemberId, tm.team_id AS teamId, tm.user_id AS userId, mp.profile_id AS profileId, u.nickname, u.email, tm.team_role AS teamRole, tm.status, tm.joined_at AS joinedAt, tm.left_at AS leftAt FROM team_member tm JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = tm.user_id LEFT JOIN member_profile mp ON mp.user_id = tm.user_id AND mp.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} AND tm.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ta.application_id AS applicationId, ta.team_id AS teamId, ta.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, tr.title AS recruitmentTitle, ta.slot_id AS slotId, r.name AS roleName, ta.applicant_user_id AS applicantUserId, mp.profile_id AS applicantProfileId, u.nickname AS applicantNickname, u.email AS applicantEmail, ta.message, ta.status, ta.reject_reason AS rejectReason, ta.decided_by AS decidedBy, decider.nickname AS decidedByNickname, ta.decided_at AS decidedAt, ta.created_at AS createdAt FROM team_application ta JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.recruitment_id = ta.recruitment_id JOIN team_recruitment_slot s ON s.slot_id = ta.slot_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = ta.applicant_user_id LEFT JOIN member_profile mp ON mp.user_id = ta.applicant_user_id AND mp.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN user_account decider ON decider.user_id = ta.decided_by WHERE ta.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY FIELD(ta.status, 'PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED'), ta.created_at DESC

SELECT ta.application_id AS applicationId, ta.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, ta.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, ta.slot_id AS slotId, r.name AS roleName, ta.applicant_user_id AS applicantUserId, u.nickname AS applicantNickname, ta.message, ta.status, ta.reject_reason AS rejectReason, ta.decided_by AS decidedBy, ta.decided_at AS decidedAt, ta.created_at AS createdAt FROM team_application ta JOIN team t ON t.team_id = ta.team_id JOIN team_recruitment_slot s ON s.slot_id = ta.slot_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = ta.applicant_user_id WHERE ta.application_id = #{applicationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE team_application SET status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT ti.invitation_id AS invitationId, ti.team_id AS teamId, ti.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, tr.title AS recruitmentTitle, ti.slot_id AS slotId, r.name AS roleName, ti.target_user_id AS targetUserId, target.nickname AS targetNickname, target.email AS targetEmail, ti.inviter_user_id AS inviterUserId, inviter.nickname AS inviterNickname, ti.message, ti.status, ti.decided_at AS decidedAt, ti.created_at AS createdAt FROM team_invitation ti JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.recruitment_id = ti.recruitment_id JOIN team_recruitment_slot s ON s.slot_id = ti.slot_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id JOIN user_account target ON target.user_id = ti.target_user_id JOIN user_account inviter ON inviter.user_id = ti.inviter_user_id WHERE ti.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY FIELD(ti.status, 'PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED'), ti.created_at DESC

SELECT ti.invitation_id AS invitationId, ti.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, ti.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, tr.title AS recruitmentTitle, ti.slot_id AS slotId, r.name AS roleName, ti.inviter_user_id AS inviterUserId, inviter.nickname AS inviterNickname, ti.message, ti.status, ti.decided_at AS decidedAt, ti.created_at AS createdAt FROM team_invitation ti JOIN team t ON t.team_id = ti.team_id JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.recruitment_id = ti.recruitment_id JOIN team_recruitment_slot s ON s.slot_id = ti.slot_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id JOIN user_account inviter ON inviter.user_id = ti.inviter_user_id WHERE ti.target_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY FIELD(ti.status, 'PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED'), ti.created_at DESC

SELECT ti.invitation_id AS invitationId, ti.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, ti.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, ti.slot_id AS slotId, r.name AS roleName, ti.target_user_id AS targetUserId, target.nickname AS targetNickname, ti.inviter_user_id AS inviterUserId, ti.message, ti.status, ti.decided_at AS decidedAt, ti.created_at AS createdAt FROM team_invitation ti JOIN team t ON t.team_id = ti.team_id JOIN team_recruitment_slot s ON s.slot_id = ti.slot_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id JOIN user_account target ON target.user_id = ti.target_user_id WHERE ti.invitation_id = #{invitationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE team_invitation SET status = #{status}, decided_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE invitation_id = #{invitationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE team_application SET status = 'CANCELED', reject_reason = '팀 종료로 자동 취소되었습니다.', updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE team_invitation SET status = 'CANCELED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE team_recruitment_slot SET accepted_count = accepted_count + 1 WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND accepted_count < required_count
UPDATE team_recruitment_slot SET status = 'CLOSED' WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND accepted_count >= required_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_recruitment (team_id, title, status, deadline_at, work_start_at, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{deadlineAt}, #{workStartAt}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE team_recruitment SET title = #{title}, status = #{status}, deadline_at = #{deadlineAt}, work_start_at = #{workStartAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE recruitment_id = #{recruitmentId} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE team_recruitment SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE recruitment_id = #{recruitmentId} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE team_recruitment SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE team_recruitment SET status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'DELETED')
UPDATE team_recruitment SET status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at < NOW()

UPDATE team_recruitment_slot SET role_id = #{roleId}, required_count = #{requiredCount}, required_experience_level = #{requiredExperienceLevel}, collaboration_condition = #{collaborationCondition}, required_yn = #{requiredYn}, role_duration = #{roleDuration}, equipment_required_yn = #{equipmentRequiredYn}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE team_recruitment_slot SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE team_recruitment_slot SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE recruitment_id = #{recruitmentId} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE team_recruitment_slot s JOIN team_recruitment r ON r.recruitment_id = s.recruitment_id SET s.status = 'DELETED', s.updated_at = NOW() WHERE r.team_id = #{teamId} AND s.status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE team_recruitment_slot s JOIN team_recruitment r ON r.recruitment_id = s.recruitment_id SET s.status = 'CLOSED' WHERE r.team_id = #{teamId} AND s.status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'DELETED')

UPDATE team_recruitment_slot s JOIN team_recruitment r ON r.recruitment_id = s.recruitment_id SET s.status = #{status}, s.updated_at = NOW() WHERE r.team_id = #{teamId} AND s.slot_id = #{slotId} AND s.status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE team_application SET status = 'CANCELED', reject_reason = '모집 공고 삭제로 자동 취소되었습니다.', updated_at = NOW() WHERE recruitment_id = #{recruitmentId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE team_invitation SET status = 'CANCELED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE recruitment_id = #{recruitmentId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE team_application SET status = 'CANCELED', reject_reason = '모집 슬롯 삭제로 자동 취소되었습니다.', updated_at = NOW() WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE team_invitation SET status = 'CANCELED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT p.plan_item_id AS planItemId, p.team_id AS teamId, p.title, p.description, p.assignee_user_id AS assigneeUserId, assignee.nickname AS assigneeNickname, p.role_id AS roleId, r.name AS roleName, p.due_at AS dueAt, p.status, p.created_by AS createdBy, creator.nickname AS createdByNickname, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM team_plan_item p LEFT JOIN user_account assignee ON assignee.user_id = p.assignee_user_id LEFT JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = p.role_id JOIN user_account creator ON creator.user_id = p.created_by WHERE p.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY FIELD(p.status, 'TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'HOLD', 'DONE', 'CANCELED'), p.due_at IS NULL, p.due_at, p.plan_item_id DESC

SELECT p.plan_item_id AS planItemId, p.team_id AS teamId, p.title, p.description, p.assignee_user_id AS assigneeUserId, assignee.nickname AS assigneeNickname, p.role_id AS roleId, r.name AS roleName, p.due_at AS dueAt, p.status, p.created_by AS createdBy, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM team_plan_item p LEFT JOIN user_account assignee ON assignee.user_id = p.assignee_user_id LEFT JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = p.role_id WHERE p.plan_item_id = #{planItemId}
mapper.update: UPDATE team_plan_item SET title = #{title}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, role_id = #{roleId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, due_at = #{dueAt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE plan_item_id = #{planItemId}
UPDATE team_plan_item SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE plan_item_id = #{planItemId}
mapper.select: SELECT closure_snapshot_id AS closureSnapshotId, team_id AS teamId, end_type AS endType, CAST(snapshot_json AS CHAR) AS snapshotJson, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM team_closure_snapshot WHERE team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, closure_snapshot_id DESC

SELECT closure_snapshot_id AS closureSnapshotId, team_id AS teamId, end_type AS endType, CAST(snapshot_json AS CHAR) AS snapshotJson, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM team_closure_snapshot WHERE closure_snapshot_id = #{closureSnapshotId}

SELECT closure_snapshot_id AS closureSnapshotId, team_id AS teamId, end_type AS endType, CAST(snapshot_json AS CHAR) AS snapshotJson, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM team_closure_snapshot WHERE team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, closure_snapshot_id DESC LIMIT 1
